browser-error: Browser playback failed. Check format, emulator support and provider CORS.
browser-limit: Browser play requires a supported core and a raw or ZIP file up to 512 MiB.
browser-loading: Loading from the provider. Your browser may need time to decompress the file.
cache-only: This collection can be used only while the provider has it cached.
close-progress: Closing this window leaves the accepted job running.
connect-hint: Create an integration link in Romio Settings, then paste it here.
device-hint: Start the companion on your PC. In its settings, approve this RomM address, configure an emulator and create a pairing code.
device-offline: The companion could not be reached. Check that it is running and this site's local network access is allowed.
discover-hint: Find a game, choose your copy, and play on your device.
indexing: The source catalog is still being indexed. More games will appear as indexing finishes.
metadata-hint: Set IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET on the RomM server to match game metadata.
native-setup: Pair your PC and configure a matching emulator in Settings to enable PC play.
no-profiles: Configure an emulator profile in the companion's local settings.
request-failed: The request could not finish. Check the connection and try again.
save-failed: Browser progress could not be saved. Try again or export your save from the emulator.
uncertain: The provider may have accepted this job. Check Romio before starting it again.
unverified: File names and sizes come from source metadata. Archive contents have not been verified.
